note: Re-judged (independent auditor). The prior weak finding (the tagged walk never reached the PAP realm ICCN, where Ze writes a Random Vector beside the one AVP it hides) is resolved by the new tag on rfc2661_iccn_proxy_flags_test.go::TestRFC2661ProxyICCNAVPFlags. Section 4.4.1, Random Vector: "This AVP MUST NOT be hidden (the H-bit MUST be 0)." The unit walks every AVP of the PAP-with-secret and CHAP proxy ICCNs built by newICCNProxy and writeICCNBody and fails on any H=1 AVP other than Proxy Authen Response (AVP 33, which Section 4.4.5 lets be hidden: "This AVP may be hidden (the H-bit may be 0 or 1)."), so a hidden Random Vector, Message Type, Tx Connect Speed, Framing Type or AVP 26 to 32 reddens it; it also requires the Random Vector and AVP 33 present, so it cannot pass vacuously. Producer read: writeAVPRandomVector writes FlagMandatory only; writeAVPHidden is called only for AVP 33 in writeICCNProxyPAP. The mutant record adding the H bit on the Random Vector header is observed red. TestRFC2661WrittenAVPFlags still covers every other emitted body. {single-polarity} accepted: avp.go::skipHiddenAVP refuses every hidden AVP on receipt, so no receive-side input distinguishes the MUST-NOT-hide set.
